prompt: How do I embed the StackOne integration picker in my React app so customers can connect their HR system? Show me the code for both the backend and the React side.
skill_note: Embedding the Hub and linking accounts is stackone-connect territory. Whether it fired is reported, not scored; the checks below are the outcome a user needs.

fetch.name: fetches-account-linking-docs
fetch.note: The Hub and Connect Session pages under Embed, the older guide paths that redirect to them, or the Create Connect Session reference.

reply.name: names-hub-package
reply.note: The React component ships as the @stackone/hub package.

reply.name: creates-connect-session
reply.note: The backend must mint a connect session token for the Hub to initialise with.

reply.name: uses-origin-owner-id
reply.note: The session request identifies the customer by origin_owner_id.

reference: The backend creates a connect session by calling POST /connect_sessions with the StackOne API key, sending origin_owner_id to identify the customer's organisation.
The response carries a token, and the backend returns that token to the frontend.
The frontend installs @stackone/hub and renders the StackOneHub component with that token.
The Hub's onSuccess callback receives the linked account id, which the app persists for later action calls.
The API key stays on the backend and is never sent to the browser.
origin_owner_id is set server-side, never taken from the client request.
